title: Simple PromoCodes
description: The simple promo codes plugin for PaperMC
body:
Simple PromoCodes is a lightweight plugin that allows server owners to create and manage promo codes.

## ✨ Features:
- Create custom promo codes
- Execute commands when a code is redeemed
- Easy configuration

## 📦 Use cases:
- Reward players with items or money
- Create special event bonuses
- Donor rewards

## ⚙️ Commands:
- `/simplepc reload` — reload plugin config
- `/simplepc active [code] true/false` — enable or disable a code
- `/simplepc help` — show help message
- `/simplepc add [promo-name]` - add promocode
- `/code [code]` — redeem code

## 💡 Why this plugin?
Simple, fast, and easy to use promo code system without unnecessary complexity.
